findings.finding: Reused message ID or sequence returns Duplicate without comparing immutable content and sequence binding.
Only pending count is capped. ACKed entries, seen IDs and ACK set grow indefinitely even with capacity one.
regressions: bounded retained state through long enqueue/ACK cycles
explicit resnapshot when retained collision evidence reaches cap

findings.finding: Public watermark/capacity permit invariant mutation; unchecked increment can overflow, and sequence zero is accepted.
Scoped helper omits CoordinationMessage::validate(); mailbox bypasses helper too. Version and payload limits can be bypassed.
regressions: no state mutation on invalid input

findings.finding: Project-label equality alone does not authorize subscriber/task membership; channel/subscription counts and resolved pages are unbounded.
Clones global snapshot then an unpaged project list; no durable subscription/replay/delivery loop or authenticated command activation is introduced.
regressions: durable recipient ACK/replay/expiry integration before activation

limitations: Existing Store append/reducer validation is retained; these findings do not allege that the durable Store path lost its checks.
Convenience wrappers and in-memory topics/mailboxes do not complete P05 acceptance.
next_action: Assign disjoint bounded mailbox/envelope repair first; pin topic authority/persistence interface before separate implementation. Keep P05 partial and preserve current production.
validation: Root inspected exact Git objects independently after subagent review; no tests on this later source claimed.
